name: How long does it take to design and build an outdoor kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design and build an outdoor kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for designing and building an outdoor kitchen can vary based on the project's complexity and current material availability. Generally, the design phase can take a few weeks to a month, allowing for revisions and approvals. Construction itself typically spans 4 to 12 weeks, depending on the extent of plumbing, electrical work, and masonry involved. Custom elements or permitting requirements can extend this timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design typically takes a few weeks, while construction can range from 4 to 12 weeks, depending on project complexity and materials.
